control_profile: Volatility-target only: weekly fast-market-state per-coin trend at 0.55 gross with no drawdown brake, position stop, time stop, or turnover throttle.
falsifier: Removing four controls reveals fragile drawdown, churn, cost, role, fold, or confidence behavior and therefore shows that the center's robustness depends on the full stack.
formation_horizon: sixty-three-day and one-hundred-twenty-six-day per-coin trends with a twenty-eight-day BTC market state
hypothesis: Holding targets fixed while retaining only the causal no-leverage volatility scaler isolates whether brakes, stops, and the turnover cap improve the fast-state signal or suppress genuine edge.
